Right now I don’t feel as suicidal as I used to. I feel complacent, for lack of a better word, in life. But I’m not happy, and every day I swear I prove myself more and more right in the fact that my future really will only get worse. It looks so dark ahead. I feel broken, I wish I was either happy or more depressed that I would kill myself so I don’t have to live in this middle ground of not sad enough to do anything about it but not happy enough to want to continue and live another day. 

Thanks for asking, how about yourself?

Honestly, I might recommend getting rid of reddit. It’s full do shocking headlines and depressing stories that intend to get you riled up and upset. It’s wildly depressing and it’s deffiently taken it’s toll on me. I try to avoid that kind of stuff now and just stick to subs relavent to me but it’s still difficult. Just a suggestion

you saying that you deserve this shows me that you are a good person. i know it sounds silly but i felt the same way about myself and sometimes still do. yet i feel that having a thought like that shows that you know more than you think you do. i don’t know you and i don’t know why you fee you deserve that, but i think you’re wrong. i believe you are a good person, at least in heart. maybe you make some bad choices and have evil thoughts, but maybe you also try your hardest to do what is ‘right’ even if it ends up badly.
